一句话作用: Build, run, and debug iOS apps on Simulator with XcodeBuildMCP. Use when launching an app, inspecting simulator UI or logs, or diagnosing runtime behavior.
关键输入: - If build fails, ask whether to retry with preferXcodebuild: true. - If the wrong app launches, confirm the scheme and bundle id. - If UI elements are not hittable, re-run describe ui after layout changes.
关键输出: - Start logs: mcp XcodeBuildMCP start sim log cap with the app bundle id. - Stop logs: mcp XcodeBuildMCP stop sim log cap and summarize important lines. - For console output, set captureConsole: true and relaunch if required.
